01-01: Name it out loud to Jesus before you leave the house today, and tell Him you are done carrying it.
01-02: Finish the one thing today that you would have quit on yesterday.
01-03: Ask the Spirit to show you one need at work or at home today. Meet it quietly, with no credit.
01-04: Write one sentence naming a new thing God is doing in you, and thank Him for it.
01-06: Write Psalm 139:14 on a card and read it out loud each time that lie comes up today.
01-07: Thank Jesus out loud for one specific thing He has forgiven you. If a man carrying guilt comes to mind, pray for him by name.
01-08: Before work, take a minute to thank the Father out loud for calling you His son through Jesus.
01-10: Say one warm thing today to the person you have been cold toward. Ask the Spirit for the words first.
01-11: Write down one step toward Jesus you want to take this year, and put it where you will see it.
01-12: Pick one habit that belongs to the old you and remove it today. Delete the app, toss the stash, or cancel it.
01-14: Start today by telling Jesus, "I can do nothing without You." Say it again before your hardest task.
01-16: Tell one person today one thing Jesus has done for you. One sentence is enough.
01-18: Read one chapter of a Gospel before you open your feed today.
01-19: Before bed, read Zephaniah 3:17 slowly and sit with it for a minute, phone down.
01-20: Do one thing you have put off, and tell Jesus you are doing it out of gratitude, not fear.
01-21: Thank God for one way He has grown you this past year. If a younger man comes to mind, tell him.
01-22: Pray Psalm 51:10 out loud once this morning and once tonight.
01-23: Forgive one person who owes you. Tell God you release him, and if you can, tell him too.
01-24: Ask the Spirit, "What do You want me doing with my life?" Sit quietly for two minutes and write down what comes.
01-25: Remove one access point to that thing today. Delete it, block it, or throw it out.
01-26: Thank God out loud that your sin is at the bottom of the sea. Text a brother one line about His mercy.
01-27: Pick one time and place to read Scripture, and read there today.
01-28: Pray by name for one man who doesn't know Jesus. If the door opens, invite him to the next Saturday gathering.
01-30: Name one thing that is costing you time with God or your family, and set it down today.
01-31: Pray over the step you wrote on January 11 and commit the rest of the year to Him.
02-01: Tell your wife in plain words today that she comes first after God.
02-02: Handle one chore she hates today, whether you feel like it or not.
02-03: Drop one complaint about her today, and own one thing about yourself instead.
02-04: Ask her one question you have never asked her, and listen to the whole answer.
02-05: Do one thing she loves today without being asked, and do not mention it afterward.
02-06: Name three things you love about her before you walk in the door tonight.
02-07: Thank her for one way she is different from you that makes your life better.
02-09: The next time anger rises, stop for ten seconds and pray before you speak.
02-10: Ask her what she would love to do together, and say yes gladly.
02-13: Go first today. Give her one kind word or act she doesn't expect, and ask for nothing back.
02-14: Kiss her and say "I love you" before you leave and when you walk in tonight.
02-15: Give Christ a few minutes in the Word and prayer before you see her today, and ask Him how to love her.
02-17: When something she does bugs you today, ask, "Does this really matter?" If not, let it go.
02-18: Make a covenant with your eyes today. Decide where you will not look, and keep it.
02-19: If there is a friendship your wife is not part of, tell her about it today.
02-20: Make it your rule from today: no private threads with another woman. Tell your wife.
02-21: Decide on one guardrail for your marriage today and tell a brother what it is.
02-22: Pray for her by name this morning. If she is willing, pray one sentence with her tonight.
02-23: Do one small act of service for her today before she notices it needs doing.
02-24: Tell her one specific thing you love about who she is today.
02-27: Put one screen or project down tonight and give that time to your wife.
02-28: Tell your wife plainly tonight that she is the only one.
02-29: Show your wife affection in front of your kids on purpose today, and thank Christ for her.
03-02: Pray before your workout today, even for one minute.
03-03: Name one craving to Jesus, ask the Spirit for help, and say no to it today.
03-05: Write your real "why" for getting healthy in one sentence, with Christ and your family in it.
03-06: Confess one hidden thing to God today. If you are ready, tell one brother too.
03-07: Offer today's workout or walk to Jesus out loud before you start.
03-08: Do the hard thing first today, and tell Jesus you are doing it for Him.
03-09: Thank Jesus out loud before each meal today.
03-10: Pick one area where the wall is down and set one clear boundary for today.
03-11: Phone out of the bedroom tonight. Hand Jesus your list in prayer before you sleep.
03-12: Take ten minutes to rest today. Stretch or walk, and pray while you do.
03-13: Tell Jesus exactly where you are tired. If a brother can help carry it, ask him.
03-14: Take a short walk today and spend the first minutes in silent prayer.
03-15: Next time you reach for comfort, stop and say "Jesus, help me" first. Then decide.
03-16: Before each choice about food or drink today, pause and ask the Spirit for self-control.
03-17: Pick up one health habit you dropped and do it today, asking the Spirit for help.
03-18: Give the weaker one ten minutes today. For your soul, read a Gospel chapter. For your body, go move.
03-19: Do one thing tonight just for joy with your wife or kids, phones away.
03-21: Decide now what you will say no to at your next meal out or event, and ask Jesus to hold you to it.
03-22: Choose your day of rest this week and guard it.
03-23: Drop one shortcut today and do it the right way, as for Jesus.
03-25: Skip the mirror check once today and thank Jesus for what your body can do.
03-26: Train hard today. Afterward, ask Jesus what He is teaching you through your hardest thing.
03-27: Take care of your body today, and give Jesus a few unhurried minutes in the Gospels.
03-28: Think of one worn-out brother and text him that you are praying for him. Then pray.
03-29: Cut off one thing today that has been poisoning your heart.
03-30: Take one step today toward the checkup you have been putting off.
03-31: Name one health habit from this month you will keep, and thank Christ for it.
04-01: Read Isaiah 53:5 out loud, and thank Jesus for one specific sin He was crushed for.
04-02: Tell God plainly the one thing you have been hiding from Him. No polish, no performance.
04-03: Read John 3:16 slowly with your own name in it. If the moment comes, tell your wife or kids what it means to you.
04-06: Name the hardest thing on your plate and pray Luke 22:42 over it.
04-07: When pressure hits today, pray before you do anything else. If a coworker is under it too, ask how he is holding up.
04-08: Set one guardrail for your weakest hour tonight, such as moving your phone out of the bedroom.
04-09: Pray for the person you have been avoiding, by name, and ask the Father to bless them.
04-12: Text one man who seems alone right now and tell him you are thinking of him.
04-14: Before your hardest task today, stop and fix your eyes on Jesus with one sentence of prayer.
04-15: Text one brother "He is risen" today.
04-16: Do one thing today that fear has kept you from. Take the first step and trust Jesus with the rest.
04-17: Do one small kindness today for someone who cannot repay you.
04-18: Show mercy to someone who wronged you today. Skip the lecture and answer with grace.
04-19: Name your biggest need out loud to God today. Ask plainly, in Jesus' name.
04-20: Pick up one thing you walked away from after you failed at it, and take one step today.
04-21: Thank Christ for meeting you in one weakness. If someone asks how you are doing today, tell the truth.
04-22: Take one step back toward God today. Open your Bible for ten minutes.
04-24: Turn one area back to God's way today. Decide which one right now and tell Him.
04-25: Confess one specific sin to God today. If it keeps its grip, tell a trusted brother.
04-26: Write down the one worry you keep carrying and hand it to God in prayer.
04-27: Give up one small comfort today, like the last word in an argument, and offer it to Jesus.
04-28: Thank Jesus that His Spirit lives in you, and ask for His power in the one place you feel weakest today.
04-29: Cancel a debt someone owes you today, money or a grudge. Tell God it is gone.
04-30: Take the lower place once today without being asked. Apologize first or ask for help.
05-01: Ask one of your kids one question about Jesus today and listen to the answer.
05-03: Show your kid how to do one thing today, hands on, and be patient while they learn.
05-05: Tell your kid you are proud of them today, with no conditions and no "but."
05-07: Pray by name for one family that does not know Jesus, and ask God to open your home to them.
05-08: Make one choice today, where nobody is watching, that you would be glad for your kids to copy.
05-09: Pray out loud over your family at dinner tonight and tell them your house follows Jesus.
05-10: Name one hard lesson God is teaching you right now, and ask the Spirit to help you submit to it.
05-11: After any correction today, follow it with a hug and the words "I love you."
05-12: Put your phone in a drawer when you get home tonight and give your kids your full attention.
05-13: Pick the one you are weakest at, comfort, urge, or build up, and use it once with your kid today.
05-14: Let someone see you follow Christ today. Pray before a meal or a hard task where it can be seen.
05-15: Lead your family in prayer at dinner tonight. If you have skipped it for weeks, start anyway.
05-16: Pray for each of your kids by name today and ask Jesus to save and shape their hearts.
05-17: Give your kids your time tonight instead of buying something, phone down.
05-18: Tell your kids one true story of how Jesus met you, failures included.
05-19: Name the issue at home you have been dodging, pray over it, and say one honest sentence about it today.
05-20: Share one piece of hard-earned wisdom with your kid today, and the mistake behind it.
05-21: Ask God to make you fruitful for the long haul, and encourage one man who is younger in the faith today.
05-22: Bring one of your kids along on an errand or task today and talk while you go.
05-23: Write your kids two sentences about why you trust Jesus, and keep them somewhere safe.
05-24: Read one Bible story about Jesus with your kids tonight and ask what stood out to them.
05-25: Text a younger man today and ask how he is really doing. Read his answer and pray for him.
05-26: Name one thing your dad got wrong, and tell God you forgive him, in Jesus' name.
05-27: Ask God what He wants to change in you as a father, and write down what comes.
05-28: Pray over each person under your roof by name today. Ask one other man how his family is doing.
05-29: Pick the area your kid needs most and ask them one question about it today.
05-30: Set one clear expectation with your kids tonight and follow through calmly.
05-31: Name one way Jesus changed your fathering in May, and thank Him for His grace over the rest.
06-01: Take your least favorite task today and do it as worship to Jesus, slowly and well.
06-02: Name the part of your job you complain about most, and offer it to God as a gift today.
06-03: Pray out loud for each person in your family tonight, by name.
06-04: Do one part of your job today with extra care, and offer the result to Christ.
06-05: Pick the task you have been putting off and start it first today.
06-06: Before you open email, write your top three tasks and pray over each one by name.
06-07: Ask one worn-out coworker how he is really doing today, and listen.
06-08: Name your biggest excuse, then do the thing it keeps you from today.
06-09: Pick the one task that matters most and give it your first focused block, phone out of reach.
06-10: Name one success you have been taking credit for, and thank Jesus for it out loud.
06-11: Give Jesus the first ten minutes tomorrow, before you touch your phone. Set the alarm tonight.
06-12: Write down your biggest money worry and pray over it. Then do today's work and let tomorrow wait.
06-13: Correct one thing at work today that is not fully honest.
06-14: Start your work today with a short prayer for one coworker by name.
06-15: Do one useful thing today for the person at work who is hardest to serve, without being asked.
06-17: Name your money worry out loud to God today and ask the Spirit for trust. Pray it with your wife if you can.
06-18: Look at your giving today and ask God whether He is getting your first or your leftovers.
06-19: Do one thing today for someone who works for you that they do not expect.
06-20: Open the account, the report, or the conversation you have been avoiding, and pray over it.
06-21: Take ten minutes outside today with no screen. Read Psalm 23 and let Him lead you.
06-22: Take the first real step today. Send the email or make the call.
06-23: Name the one distraction that steals the most from your work, and turn it off until your main task is done.
06-24: Pick one big decision you have been rushing, and pray about it before you act.
06-25: Write "if the Lord wills" at the top of today's plan, and pray over it.
06-26: Take one small, honest step with your money today, and thank God for what He has provided.
06-27: Recognize one person on your team by name today, and be specific about what they did.
06-28: Text a younger man one thing you wish someone had told you about Christ.
06-29: Get up on time tomorrow, no snooze, and give the day to Jesus before your feet hit the floor.
06-30: Name one win and one miss from June. Thank Jesus for the win and confess the miss to Him.
07-01: Do one thing today you have been afraid to do. Pray first, out loud, in Jesus' name.
07-02: Write that promise on a card, keep it in your pocket, and read it once today.
07-03: Name your biggest fear out loud to God, and ask the Holy Spirit for power, love and self-control.
07-04: Thank a veteran by name today, in person or by text, and thank Christ for your freedom in Him.
07-05: Text the one person you have been avoiding today. A simple hello is enough to start.
07-06: Write your giant on paper, pray over it in Jesus' name, and take one small step toward it today.
07-07: Be faithful in one unseen thing today, and ask one coworker how he is really doing.
07-08: Say the hard thing that needs saying to one person today, and say it with love.
07-10: Bring what you are hiding into the light with God today. If you are ready, tell a trusted brother or your wife.
07-11: Give Jesus ten minutes today, phone away, in Scripture and prayer. Then go face your day.
07-12: Read Psalm 56:3 three times today, and say it out loud the next time your stomach drops.
07-13: Take one faith risk today: a conversation, a call, a decision. Keep your eyes on Jesus, not the waves.
07-14: Ask God for strength for the long haul, and encourage one younger man by text today.
07-16: Text a man in a hard season today. Tell him you are praying for him.
07-17: Name the one thing God has called you to in your home, work, or church, and take one small step toward it today.
07-18: Say yes today to one thing you have dodged because you feel unqualified.
07-20: Pick the task you have been avoiding and start it today. Pray in Jesus' name first.
07-21: Name the news you have been avoiding and bring it to the Lord first. Then take one step to face it today.
07-22: Three times today, stop for ten seconds and ask Jesus for strength.
07-25: Name that battle to God today, do your part, and leave the result with Him. Ask one brother to pray.
07-26: In your next tense conversation, say one sentence of faith out loud, like "God is with us in this."
07-27: Write three sentences today: life before Christ, how you met Him, life now.
07-28: Text one man who seems weighed down and ask how he is really doing.
07-29: Make the call, send the email, or have the talk you have been dreading today.
07-30: Write down three things you are trusting God for, and pray over them.
07-31: Name one place Christ carried you through fear in July, and thank Him for it.
08-01: Ask one friend today, "Where do you see me drifting?" Then listen without defending yourself.
08-02: Call that one friend today. Not a text. A call, even a short one.
08-03: Text one man who is hurting today and ask what he needs.
08-04: Decide today that you will be at the next gathering, and tell one brother you will see him there.
08-05: Tell one trusted brother one sentence about the struggle you have been hiding.
08-06: Do one thing today that helps a friend get ahead, even if it costs you credit.
08-07: Pray by name for one brother who is worn out, and text him that you did.
08-08: Thank the friend who last told you something hard.
08-09: Ask one friend today, "What can I take off your plate?" Then do it if you can.
08-10: Text a man going through divorce, job loss, or grief today and ask how he is really doing.
08-11: Text one man today something specific you see God doing in him.
08-12: Reach out to one man who has fallen. Send grace, not a lecture.
08-13: Thank one man who makes you better, and tell him why.
08-14: Be the one who raises the standard in one conversation today, without preaching.
08-15: The next time you are with a brother, pray together out loud before you leave.
08-16: Text the man you are at odds with today: "I want to make this right."
08-17: Pray by name for one friend who doesn't know Jesus. If the door opens, invite him.
08-18: Congratulate a friend on a win today, out loud or by text.
08-19: Go to the brother you have an issue with, not around him. Start by telling him you value him.
08-20: Ask a brother today how you can pray for him, and pray for him right then.
08-21: Say hello today to one man who seems alone, and ask about his life before his work.
08-22: Keep one promise you made to a friend, or tell him today when you will.
08-23: Don't offer help today. Do one small thing for a brother without being asked.
08-24: Name the friendship that pulls you from Christ, and set one kind, clear boundary today.
08-25: Ask one brother today to read the same passage as you this week.
08-26: Thank an older man who has shaped you, or encourage a younger man, with one text today.
08-27: Say a good word today about a man who has been overlooked.
08-28: Text one brother today: one prayer and one win. Ask for his.
08-29: Text a friend a passage of Scripture today and one line on why it matters to you.
08-30: Follow through today on the one commitment you have been putting off.
08-31: Name the friendship that grew in August, thank Christ for it, and text that brother.
09-01: Name your most common temptation and the exit you will take the next time it comes.
09-03: Ask the Spirit for help, then physically leave one tempting situation today. Close the laptop or walk out.
09-04: Say your covenant out loud to God this morning, in your own words.
09-05: Close one door to lust today. Add a filter, delete an app, or move a screen out of your room.
09-06: Decide now what you will do with your usual idle hour today, and do it.
09-07: Stay clear-headed tonight. Skip the drink and pray for one brother by name before bed.
09-08: Read one chapter of Mark today and notice one thing Jesus does.
09-09: Pick one line of Scripture that fits your biggest temptation and say it out loud three times today.
09-10: Answer your next temptation out loud with a line of Scripture. Use yesterday's verse.
09-11: Take a few quiet minutes today and tell Jesus exactly what you are tempted by. He is not shocked.
09-12: Tell one trusted brother one sentence about the thing you have been hiding.
09-13: Confess one thing to God right now. If you wronged someone, tell him you are sorry today.
09-14: Clear one tempting thing out of your house or phone today.
09-15: Unfollow, unsubscribe, or delete one worthless thing today.
09-16: Pick that one place and change one thing today so you are the same man there.
09-17: Tell the plain truth in every conversation today. No spin, no padding the numbers.
09-19: Keep one promise today that you have been putting off.
09-20: Name the one area where you keep losing. Hand it to God in prayer this morning, then resist there today.
09-21: When the craving to numb out hits today, stop and ask the Spirit to fill you instead.
09-22: Change one route, time, or habit today that leads you toward sin.
09-23: Tell one brother honestly where you stand today. One text is enough.
09-24: Ask the Spirit to show you one blind spot, and listen without defending yourself.
09-25: Name the thing and put real distance between you and it today.
09-26: When the pull comes today, say no and whisper, "Jesus already paid for me."
09-27: Read Psalm 139:23-24 slowly tonight, and bring whatever God shows you to Jesus.
09-28: Go without one thing you lean on today, and turn to Jesus each time you reach for it.
09-29: Fix one thing at work today that would not hold up to inspection.
09-30: Thank Jesus for one temptation you beat this month and confess one you lost. He keeps you.
10-01: Pray three one-sentence prayers today, wherever you are. Start each with "Jesus."
10-02: Shut a door today and pray alone to the Father for a few minutes.
10-03: Open every prayer today with one line of praise to the Father before you ask for anything.
10-04: Name the one person you have not forgiven, and tell Jesus you release the debt.
10-05: Pray Matthew 6:13 out loud before you pick up your phone today.
10-06: Name the one thing you quit praying about, and ask for it again today.
10-07: Hand Jesus the thing you are anxious about, with thanks. If a coworker looks stressed, ask how he is doing.
10-08: Pray, then sit in silence for five minutes with your phone in another room.
10-09: Ask God for wisdom on that decision today, and expect Him to give it.
10-11: Pray before your feet hit the floor tomorrow, before you reach for your phone.
10-13: Pray for your wife and kids by name today, asking for their faith in Jesus.
10-14: Be still for five minutes today with no phone, and tell God, "You are God, and I am not."
10-15: Name one broken thing in your neighborhood, job, or church, and pray for it by name today.
10-16: Stop three times today, morning, noon, and night, and pray for one minute.
10-17: Step away alone for a few minutes today and pray, outside if you can.
10-18: Pray for your pastor and your boss by name today. Text your pastor that you did.
10-19: Pray out loud with one man today, in person or on the phone. One minute is enough.
10-20: Humble yourself today: confess one specific sin to Jesus by name, and turn from it.
10-21: Pray for one sick person by name today, and tell him you did.
10-22: Pour it all out to God today, out loud or on paper. Hold nothing back.
10-23: Pick one big request, like a brother's salvation or a marriage, and pray it today.
10-25: Pray today for one coworker or neighbor by name. If it fits, tell him, "I prayed for you today."
10-26: Go somewhere private and cry out to God about it, out loud.
10-27: Spend your prayer time today only thanking Jesus. Name five specific things.
10-28: Take a short walk today and pray for the homes you pass.
10-29: Pray for three men by name today, and text one to say so.
10-30: Pray out loud tonight where your kids or your wife can hear you.
10-31: Pick one prayer habit from this month and keep it today.
11-01: Name five things you're thankful for today, with Jesus first on the list.
11-02: Name the one thing you keep wishing you had. Tell Jesus about it, then thank Him for what you do have.
11-03: Ask Christ for strength to be content in your hardest area today. Text a brother to pray if you need it.
11-04: Thank Christ that He is your gain. If you see a need you can meet with something you own, meet it.
11-05: Pass on one thing you don't need today, and tell Jesus He is enough.
11-07: Name three benefits you have in Christ, and tell one person about one of them today.
11-08: Go back to Jesus right now and thank Him for one answered prayer you never thanked Him for.
11-09: Thank Jesus out loud for your paycheck, and don't think about the next raise today.
11-10: Hold one thing you own with an open hand today. Tell Jesus it is His, and share it if someone needs it.
11-11: Thank a veteran by name today, in person or by text.
11-12: Tell your wife tonight one thing about her you've taken for granted.
11-13: Pray a blessing over the man you envy, by name. Then thank God for what He gave you.
11-14: When you catch yourself comparing today, stop and thank Jesus for one thing He has done in you.
11-15: Look around your home or neighborhood tonight and thank Jesus out loud for three things you see.
11-16: Praise Jesus out loud today for who He is, not for what He's given.
11-17: Replace every complaint you catch today with a thank-you to Jesus.
11-18: Ask your wife tonight if your work is costing your family peace, and listen.
11-19: Look at where your money went this month and ask Jesus what it says about your treasure.
11-20: Tell your family at dinner one way God has been good to your house this year.
11-21: Thank God out loud before you eat today. If someone has nowhere to go this Thanksgiving, make room at your table.
11-22: Let Christ's peace rule one grudge today. Pray for that person by name and forgive your part of it.
11-23: Give something today, gladly. Any size counts.
11-24: Share one specific thing Jesus did for you this year with someone at your table.
11-25: Thank God for one hard season and how Christ carried you through it.
11-26: Pray this passage over your finances today.
11-28: Ask a coworker who seems worn down how he's holding up, and listen.
11-29: Put Jesus first on today's gratitude list, and thank Him for what He gave you at the cross.
11-30: Read back over your gratitude this month, thank Jesus, and tell Him He is enough.
12-01: Pick that name and pray to Jesus by it today.
12-02: Name that dead area to God today and ask Him for new life there. Ask a brother to pray with you.
12-03: Finish one small task you keep putting off, and ask the Spirit for help before you start.
12-05: Do it today. If it takes a conversation, start it with one text.
12-06: Name that sin out loud to Jesus this morning, and thank Him that His name means the Lord saves.
12-07: Pick one thing today you will do on purpose, not by drift, and do it for Christ.
12-08: Write that impossible thing down and pray over it out loud today.
12-09: Make room for Jesus today. Give Him ten minutes in Scripture and prayer before the day fills up.
12-10: Ask one coworker how his Christmas is going today, and listen.
12-11: Before you pick up your phone this morning, read Luke 2:14 and praise Jesus out loud.
12-12: Take a few quiet minutes tonight and name three things Jesus did in your life this year.
12-13: Thank one coworker by name today for something specific he does.
12-14: Keep one good habit today that December usually pushes out, and offer it to Jesus.
12-15: Be present in person for one person today. Walk over instead of texting.
12-16: Do a humble job at home today that you usually leave to someone else. Don't mention it.
12-17: Give Jesus your best in one thing today: your time, your money, or a habit.
12-18: Pray out loud over your household tonight and ask God to make you ready.
12-19: Tell God what you are waiting on, and ask Him for peace while you wait.
12-20: Pick one deadline you've been forcing and hand it to God in prayer.
12-21: Take a short walk before the busiest part of your day and ask Jesus for His peace.
12-22: Name the one obstacle between you and the Lord and take one step to clear it today.
12-23: Tell Jesus your heaviest burden by name this morning, and leave it with Him tonight.
12-24: Reach out to one lonely or grieving person today. A short text or call is enough.
12-25: Read Luke 2:1-20 aloud with your family today and thank Jesus together.
12-26: Do that one thing today. Make the call, say the apology, or start the conversation.
12-27: Name the one area you've kept for yourself and surrender it to Jesus out loud.
12-28: Write one faith goal for next year and commit it to the Lord.
12-29: Text one hurting person today the hope you have because Jesus rose.
12-30: Tell your kids or a younger man one specific thing God did for you this year.
12-31: Name one win, one failure, and one lesson from this year, and thank Jesus for His grace over each.
